text:
Nora: Thanks for the runtime deep-dive — a few clarifying items for the roadmap doc and follow-ups from leadership Q&A:

- Microbatch defaults: what's safe for latency-sensitive chat vs bulk embeddings? Any dynamic switching guidance?
- KV cache nuance: for multi-tenant routes do we fully isolate keys or use shared-prefix caching after pin window? Any tenant-safety caveats?
- Kernel canary ownership and emergency rollback flow (who calls the rollback and what telemetry gates do we use?)
- PM-friendly telemetry: one dashboard name + three signals we can point to.

Felix: Short answers from runtime leads:
- Microbatching: chat (latency-first) default max_batch=8; ultra-low-latency routes can use 4 with 100ms flush. Bulk/embeddings default 64 (128 on A100). Dynamic switching supported via route hints but requires infra rollout (not self-serve yet).

Gita: KV cache: strict tenant namespacing at keying layer, plus per-session pinning (2-5m). After pin window we fall back to best-effort shared-prefix caching for cost. No cross-tenant leakage possible if you use session_id namespacing; still treat cache as advisory not source of truth. Eviction = TTL (30m) + size-LRU.

Asha: Canary & rollback: runtime schedules canaries (default 5% / 30m). Gates: p95 token-latency, request success rate, and memory/oom signals. Automated fallback routes to quantized-compatible variant after sustained latency breach (30s). Emergency revert authority = SRE on-call (they can partial-drain + rollback). Normal auto-rollback if error rate >0.8% in window.

Felix: Minimal canary snippet to paste into roadmap doc:
```
canary:
  traffic_fraction: 0.05
  duration_minutes: 30
  trace_sample_rate: 1.0
  gates:
    - p95_token_latency_ms: 200
    - error_rate_pct: 0.8
  fallback_variant: quantized-stable
```

Gita: Telemetry for PMs: dashboard "Runtime / Route SLOs" with these three signals: p50/p95 token-latency (single graph), request success rate, and cost per 1k tokens. Add model-variant traffic split as a small widget for rollouts.

SRE-Bot: Canary scheduled: canary/2356789012 at 2026-06-01T17:00:00Z. Alerts: runtime-canary-latency, runtime-canary-memory, runtime-canary-errors.

Nora: Thanks — can folks drop representative prewarm prompts (1 short convo, 1 long ~1500 tokens, 1 embedding batch) and link the staging dashboard and rollback playbook? I'll fold into the all-hands notes and route to leadership.

Asha: Staging dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/omega/runtime-batching-staging (histograms + memory traces). Rollback playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/playbooks/runtime-rollback

Felix: Prewarm prompts: short: "TL;DR this chat in one sentence." long: 1500-token repeated policy excerpt. embeddings: 128 small JSON docs. I'll add a tiny script to the canary repo to run these.

Nora: Great — tagging @SRE and @runtime leads for tabletop. I'll publish a 1-page checklist and ping when notes are live. Closing thread for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
